crossRefs.note: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for…
When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house, and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,
Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death; because he weakens the hands of the men of war…
Behold, today your eyes have seen how Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill…
Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For Yahweh will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord…
Though men may rise up to pursue you, and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of…
He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?
For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.
Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their…
Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies…
They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
Moreover Jeremiah said to king Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you, against your servants, or against this people…
But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

translations.web: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
translations.bsb: Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
translations.kjv: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
translations.asv: They have chased me sore like a bird, they that are mine enemies without cause.
